name: Austral-Hoodoo
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past an ancient meteor crater, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.

For traders, carbon, dark crystals, helium-3 and nitrogen alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
